Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: An employee expense-reimbursement claim (onkostendeclaratie / declaratie). An employee submits a claim (amount, category, date, receipt), a manager approves or rejects it, and once approved the amount is reimbursed to the employee. The submit → approve → reimburse lifecycle is owned here in hrmq, the HR/labour app — re-homing the Expenses feature that previously lived in pipelinq. The pipelinq-specific Shillinq accounts-payable sync coupling is intentionally NOT ported: reimbursement here is the HR-side claim workflow; any downstream AP/GL posting is a separate integration concern that OpenConnector/shillinq own.

submit.description: The employee submits the expense claim for manager approval. A rejected claim may be corrected and re-submitted.

approve.description: A manager approves the claim. The NoSelfApprovalGuard rejects self-approval (the approver may not be the claiming employee); approvedBy and approvedAt are stamped on the carrying write.

reject.description: A manager rejects the claim (with a rejectionReason). The NoSelfApprovalGuard rejects self-rejection. The employee may correct it and re-submit.

reimburse.description: The approved claim is paid out to the employee; reimbursedAt records the payout date. Terminal.

employeeId.description: Reference to the Employee who submitted the claim (the claimant). Drives the self-approval guard — the approver may not equal this employee.

amount.description: Claimed amount in the configured currency. Reused by OpenRegister aggregations for per-employee and per-status totals.

expenseDate.description: The date the expense was incurred (ISO 8601).

receiptFile.description: Reference (Nextcloud Files path or OpenRegister file id) to the attached receipt / bon.

status.description: Reimbursement workflow status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine.

submittedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the employee submitted the claim.

approvedBy.description: User ID of the manager who approved (or rejected) the claim. Must differ from the claiming employee (no self-approval).

approvedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of approval or rejection.

rejectionReason.description: Reason the manager rejected the claim, shown to the employee so it can be corrected and re-submitted.

reimbursedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp the approved claim was paid out to the employee.
